lines.text: What actually happens on a free Leak Audit?
First, five quick questions: your leads, reply time, estimates, jobs, and software.
Then a thirty-minute call. We map your funnel live, from first call to paid job.
You'll see exactly where jobs leak out, and what each leak costs you.
You get a one-page leak report, with the two or three fixes to build first.
No pitch deck. No long contracts. Get your free Leak Audit.
